Background: solid #b9cddd filling the square, visible in all open areas and unoccupied corners.
Subject: one extremely simple, adorable baby bear character, clearly recognizable by two round ears. This is a friendly shopping safety guardian. Constraints: One animal only, holding exactly one shield. No text, watermark, borders, frames, scenery, extra characters, weapons, decorative marks, thin fragile lines, sharp tips, detailed fur, photorealistic materials, glossy hotspots, strong three-dimensional rendering, or external cast shadow.
